messages:
kevin: quick question - i was hired through the EU contractor partner (PaidGlobal) until 2025-05-31, then converted to FT on 2025-06-15 and moved to ireland. payroll shows no Irish tax withheld and flagged as "no foreign tax" on my paystub. worried about local PAYE exposure and double taxation. anyone seen this with EOR transitions?

nina (People Ops): hi @kevin - thanks for the heads up. can you confirm: were you on EOR payroll (PaidGlobal) during contractor period and did they issue any payslips or local tax docs? did you enroll in benefits yet?

kevin: paid by PaidGlobal, they issued monthly payslips and deducted Irish PAYE while I was there in Q1 2025. after conversion we set up local payroll but my profile shows country=IE and tax_status=nonresident in our system. payroll stub shows "Foreign tax credit: 0" and no PAYE withholding.

oscar (Payroll): @kevin i'm pulling your record. appears that when we imported your hire file, the tax residency flag defaulted to nonresident which disables local withholding. for employees based in Ireland we should enable PAYE withholding and register PRSI/USC where applicable. Action: we'll enable local tax deductions and run a supplemental to capture expected PAYE withheld for the conversion period. Need confirmation of your PPSN and confirmation you completed the local tax form (form 12? or PAYE modernisation intake).

tara (Tax Counsel): two quick points: 1) double taxation risk: if you were subject to Irish tax during the contractor period via PaidGlobal and we also remit PAYE for the same income, you'll likely get credit for foreign taxes when filing. But we should avoid duplicate withholding on the same income. 2) Residency: the company should determine tax residency per Ireland rules (days/center of interests). If you're a tax resident, payroll should withhold. If not, we may need to gross up or adjust.

kevin: i completed the onboarding checklist and uploaded PPSN. i don't remember filling an irish tax form in our HRIS. i'll attach PaidGlobal payslips to PAY-3389.

oscar (Payroll): thanks - once we have the PaidGlobal payslips we'll reconcile. likely outcome: we run a retro withholding for wages we should have collected since conversion and then coordinate with Tax Counsel oncredits/refunds for the EOR payments. ETA: 5 business days after docs attached.

kevin: appreciate it. not ideal timing with filing season but at least we have a plan.

nina (People Ops): note for process improvement: when converting from EOR/partner to local payroll, we need a checklist step to confirm tax_residency flag and local tax form completion. i'll open a process ticket.

oscar (Payroll): PAY-3389 opened. payroll will reconcile upon receipt of payslips.

kevin: thanks team. i'll upload the docs now.
